description: Create a new dunning from an invoice via `POST /dunnings?precedingSalesVoucherId={id}`; dunnings are always created as drafts and do not need finalization. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

body.description: Dunning JSON body with voucherDate, address (contactId or manual fields), lineItems, totalPrice, and taxConditions. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

precedingSalesVoucherId.description: UUID of the preceding invoice that this dunning is pursued from. Required by the Lexware API.

name: lexware_pursue_dunning
title: Pursue to a Dunning
